sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Jorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-霍尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mamdani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、佐兰·马姆达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews at nytimes.com and in the Times app on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 网站和《纽约时报》应用程序上直播部分采访。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你们一定不会想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: Today, Senator Elizabeth Warren has emerged as the loudest voice of liberal resistance in the age of Trump.
sentences.zh: 今天，参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦已经成为特朗普时代自由派抵抗力量的最强音。

sentences.en: But is she actually a danger to the Democratic Party?
sentences.zh: 但她真的对民主党构成了危险吗？

sentences.en: Plus, the secret document everyone in American finance wants to read, our reporter has a copy.
sentences.zh: 另外，美国金融界每个人都想阅读的那份秘密文件，我们的记者拿到了一份副本。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月9日，星期四。

sentences.en: We can whimper, we can whine, or we can fight back.
sentences.zh: 我们可以啜泣，我们可以抱怨，或者我们可以奋起反抗。

sentences.en: Me, I'm here to fight back.
sentences.zh: 而我，我是来反抗的。

sentences.en: She was there at the Women's March in Boston the day after President Trump's inauguration.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统就职典礼的第二天，她出现在波士顿的女性大游行现场。

sentences.en: Children!
sentences.zh: 孩子们！

sentences.en: We will not turn away children!
sentences.zh: 我们不会将孩子们拒之门外！

sentences.en: She was there, shouting into the crowd at Logan Airport, a red bullhorn in her hand, in the hours after the immigration ban.
sentences.zh: 在移民禁令颁布后的几个小时里，她站在洛根机场的人群中高喊，手里拿着一个红色的扩音器。

sentences.en: It is illegal!
sentences.zh: 这是非法的！

sentences.en: Constitutional!
sentences.zh: 违宪的！

sentences.en: It is unconstitutional!
sentences.zh: 这是违宪的！

sentences.en: At seemingly every moment of resistance since Donald Trump's election, Elizabeth Warren has shown up and become the face of Democratic outrage and a hero to the left.
sentences.zh: 自唐纳德·特朗普当选以来，几乎在每一次抵抗的时刻，伊丽莎白·沃伦都现身并成为了民主党愤怒的面孔和左翼的英雄。

sentences.en: Jennifer, why Elizabeth Warren when it theoretically could be Bernie Sanders or Joe Biden or Tim Kaine?
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗，在理论上可以是伯尼·桑德斯、乔·拜登或蒂姆·凯恩的情况下，为什么偏偏是伊丽莎白·沃伦？

sentences.en: Why has she become the voice of the progressive left?
sentences.zh: 为什么她会成为进步左翼的声音？

sentences.en: Jennifer Steinhauer covers Congress for the Times.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗·斯坦豪尔为《时报》报道国会新闻。

sentences.en: So, I think, first of all, when you think about Elizabeth Warren, you need to think about how she came on the scene in the Senate to begin with,
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为，首先，当你想到伊丽莎白·沃伦时，你需要想想她最初是如何登上参议院舞台的，

sentences.en: which she was basically chosen by Chuck Schumer to challenge Scott Brown.
sentences.zh: 基本上是查克·舒默选择她去挑战斯科特·布朗。

sentences.en: Senator Scott Brown had come to represent the Tea Party movement, and Warren was the left's answer to that, if you will.
sentences.zh: 参议员斯科特·布朗当时代表了茶党运动，而沃伦可以说是左翼对该运动的回应。

sentences.en: And that's kind of been her brand.
sentences.zh: 这基本上成了她的个人标签。

sentences.en: She's not known as the person who's famous for certain pieces of legislation.
sentences.zh: 她并不是以因某些特定立法而闻名的人。

sentences.en: She's known as the person who rabble-rouss it.
sentences.zh: 她因煽动民众而闻名。

sentences.en: She's known as the person who gives nominees a hard time in a hearing.
sentences.zh: 她因在听证会上给被提名人制造困难而闻名。

sentences.en: And this is the position that she's taken.
sentences.zh: 这就是她所选择的立场。

sentences.en: It's the identity she's chosen.
sentences.zh: 这是她选择的身份。

sentences.en: So, it makes perfect sense.
sentences.zh: 所以，这完全合乎情理。

sentences.en: And she won't be the only voice from the left, I would suspect, as we continue through the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 我猜，在我们经历特朗普政府的过程中，她不会是左翼唯一的发声者。

sentences.en: But right now, she is the most resonant one.
sentences.zh: 但目前，她是最具共鸣的那一个。

sentences.en: So, all this momentum that we're seeing in rally after rally or event after event where she pops up, it feels like Republicans tried to put a stop to that on Tuesday night.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在一个又一个集会或她出现的活动中看到的所有这些声势，感觉像是共和党人试图在周二晚上制止这一切。

sentences.en: They are mothers, daughters, sisters, fathers, sons, and brothers.
sentences.zh: 她们是母亲、女儿、姐妹、父亲、儿子和兄弟。

sentences.en: It was a very specific and deliberate action to read the words of Coretta Scott King, the wife of slain civil rights leader Martin Luther King, on the Senate floor.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常具体和刻意的行动，即在参议院大厅宣读已故民权领袖马丁·路德·金的妻子科雷塔·斯科特·金的话。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine a lot of other senators even trying to do that.
sentences.zh: 很难想象许多其他参议员甚至会试图这样做。

sentences.en: Sons and brothers.
sentences.zh: 儿子和兄弟。

sentences.en: Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 议长先生。

sentences.en: They are...
sentences.zh: 他们是……

sentences.en: Majority leader.
sentences.zh: 多数党领袖。

sentences.en: Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 议长先生。

sentences.en: The majority leader.
sentences.zh: 多数党领袖。

sentences.en: The senators impugn the motives and conduct of our colleague from Alabama as warned by the chair.
sentences.zh: 正如主席所警告的那样，参议员是在质疑我们来自亚拉巴马州的同僚的动机和品行。

sentences.en: Senator Warren, quote, said Senator Sessions has used the awesome power of his office to chill the free exercise of the vote by black citizens.
sentences.zh: 沃伦参议员，“引用原话，称瑟申斯参议员利用其办公室的巨大权力来压制黑人公民自由行使投票权。”

sentences.en: I call the senator to order under the provisions of Rule 19.
sentences.zh: 根据第19条规则的规定，我要求该参议员遵守秩序。

sentences.en: Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 议长先生。

sentences.en: The senator from Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 马萨诸塞州参议员。

sentences.en: Mr. President, I am surprised that the words of Coretta Scott King are not suitable for debate in the United States Senate.
sentences.zh: 议长先生，我很惊讶科雷塔·斯科特·金的话竟然不适合在美国参议院进行辩论。

sentences.en: I ask leave of the Senate to continue my remarks.
sentences.zh: 我请求参议院准许我继续发言。

sentences.en: Is there objection?
sentences.zh: 有异议吗？

sentences.en: Object.
sentences.zh: 反对。

sentences.en: I appeal the ruling...
sentences.zh: 我对此裁决提出上诉……

sentences.en: Object.
sentences.zh: 反对。

sentences.en: Objection is heard.
sentences.zh: 听到异议。

sentences.en: The senator will take her seat.
sentences.zh: 参议员请就座。

sentences.en: She likes these really grand gestures.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢这种非常宏大的姿态。

sentences.en: Other people might have entered it into the record, which means, you know, please put this in the record, the congressional record.
sentences.zh: 其他人可能会将其记录在案，也就是，你知道的，请把这放进记录里，国会记录中。

sentences.en: But I won't read it.
sentences.zh: 但我不会读它。

sentences.en: I'm not going to dramatically read it from the floor.
sentences.zh: 我不会在议会大厅里戏剧性地朗读它。

sentences.en: But for her, that did become, because of the unusual aspect of it procedurally and because of what she was fighting about.
sentences.zh: 但对她而言，由于其在程序上的不寻常之处以及她所争取的内容，这确实成为了……

sentences.en: Jeff Sessions, right?
sentences.zh: 杰夫·瑟申斯，对吧？

sentences.en: Jeff Sessions, who is the nominee for attorney general, has been under fire, which is a nominee who, frankly,
sentences.zh: 杰夫·瑟申斯作为总检察长的被提名人，一直饱受抨击，坦率地说，他是一个……

sentences.en: a lot of Democrats are resisting because of what they think are his racial insensitivities at a very intense time on that subject for our country.
sentences.zh: 许多民主党人都在抵制他，因为在这个国家关于这个主题高度紧张的时期，他们认为他在种族问题上不够敏感。

sentences.en: So I think it's timing, it's person, it's subject.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是时机、人物和主题的结合。

sentences.en: It makes me think that they see her as a real threat.
sentences.zh: 这让我觉得他们视她为真正的威胁。

sentences.en: Do they?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think there's two ways to look at this, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为看待这一点有两种方式，对吧？

sentences.en: And I'm not going to try to get inside the mind of Senator Mitch McConnell because that's just a place I don't belong.
sentences.zh: 我不会去试图窥探米奇·麦康奈尔参议员的内心，因为那不是我该涉足的地方。

sentences.en: But I think there's two ways to think of it.
sentences.zh: 但我认为可以从两种方式来思考这个问题。

sentences.en: One is, do they see that as a threat?
sentences.zh: 一是，他们是否将这视为威胁？

sentences.en: Are they trying to put a stop to her?
sentences.zh: 他们是否在试图阻止她？

sentences.en: Are they trying to put an answer to her?
sentences.zh: 他们是否在试图对她做出回击？

sentences.en: That could be.
sentences.zh: 这很有可能。

sentences.en: But let's look at this in a different way.
sentences.zh: 但让我们从另一个角度来看待这个问题。

sentences.en: Do they see her as the perfect threat?
sentences.zh: 他们是否视她为完美的威胁？

sentences.en: Do they see her as too far to the left where people being associated with her actually damages the party?
sentences.zh: 他们是否认为她过于左倾，以至于与她扯上关系的人实际上会损害民主党？

sentences.en: In some ways, I think about this.
sentences.zh: 从某些方面来看，我是这么想的。

sentences.en: I hate all these Super Bowl analogies.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌所有这些超级碗的比喻。

sentences.en: I truly hate them.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常讨厌它们。

sentences.en: But I do sort of think this is like the Patriots just wearing the Falcons down.
sentences.zh: 但我确实觉得这有点像爱国者队在一点点消耗猎鹰队的体力。

sentences.en: Are they just trying to work Democrats into such a frenzy as they did when she was chastised in the floor of the Senate, which was very unusual,
sentences.zh: 他们是否只是在激怒民主党人，就像她在参议院大厅遭到训斥时那样（这非常罕见），

sentences.en: so that they get angry about everything and eventually kind of peter out?
sentences.zh: 好让民主党人对每件事都感到愤怒，最终却不了了之？

sentences.en: This is another theory, right?
sentences.zh: 这是另一种理论，对吧？

sentences.en: Wait, so are you potentially arguing that they're actually trying to elevate her and therefore marginalize the rest of the party?
sentences.zh: 等等，所以你是否可能在争辩说，他们实际上是在试图抬高她，从而边缘化党内的其他人？

sentences.en: I want to understand exactly what you mean.
sentences.zh: 我想准确理解你的意思。

sentences.en: I think that there is a reasonable theory to posit that, in fact, they see Elizabeth Warren for what she is, which is a symbol of the far progressive left.
sentences.zh: 我认为有一个合理的理论可以提出，事实上，他们看清了伊丽莎白·沃伦的本质，也就是极左翼进步派的象征。

sentences.en: She's kind of anointed herself that and the left has embraced that and that she will ultimately lead her party too far to the left and damage them.
sentences.zh: 她某种程度上自封了这一角色，左翼也接受了这一点，她最终将带领她的党派过于向左倾斜并损害他们。

sentences.en: And so why not help her along?
sentences.zh: 所以为什么不推波助澜呢？

sentences.en: And it feels like the Democrats are looking for a certain kind of ferocity in whoever it is they're going to be turning to in this moment because of who Donald Trump is and how confrontational he is.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉由于唐纳德·特朗普是谁以及他的对抗性有多强，民主党人在他们此时此刻要求助的任何人身上都在寻找某种凶猛的特质。

sentences.en: I mean, is it because Democrats want it that she's doing it?
sentences.zh: 我是说，是因为民主党人想要这样，她才这么做的吗？

sentences.en: You know, I would just point out that she does this on her terMs.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我只想指出，她是在她自己的节奏下做这些事的。

sentences.en: She's not a spontaneous person.
sentences.zh: 她不是一个情绪冲动的人。

sentences.en: She's not spontaneous rage.
sentences.zh: 她不是那种 spontaneouse rage（无端狂怒）的人。

sentences.en: She picks her issues.
sentences.zh: 她精心挑选她的议题。

sentences.en: She picks her moments.
sentences.zh: 她精心挑选她的时机。

sentences.en: She comes in.
sentences.zh: 她登场。

sentences.en: She grills a nominee.
sentences.zh: 她盘问被提名人。

sentences.en: She gives her speech.
sentences.zh: 她发表她的演讲。

sentences.en: Seedingly well-prepared.
sentences.zh: 准备得极其充分。

sentences.en: Seedingly well-prepared.
sentences.zh: 准备得极其充分。

sentences.en: And then she doesn't walk down the hallway and then give 97 different interviews trying to explain her position.
sentences.zh: 然后她不会走出走廊去接受97次不同的采访来试图解释她的立场。

sentences.en: She generally rushes out of the building down to Rachel Maddow, who she feels is the appropriate platform for her to continue in this spirit with people who think like her,
sentences.zh: 她通常会冲出大楼，去找雷切尔·马多，她认为这是她继续这种精神、与和她志同道合的人交流的合适平台，

sentences.en: basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是这样。

sentences.en: She's kind of very much a symbol of our current media age.
sentences.zh: 她可以说是我们当前媒体时代的典型象征。

sentences.en: She speaks to people through people who share her viewpoints.
sentences.zh: 她通过那些与她观点相同的人向大众发言。

sentences.en: Does she have a desire to reach beyond that, the Maddow America, and become any kind of a unifying populist force?
sentences.zh: 她是否有愿望超越那个圈子——马多的美国，并成为某种具有凝聚力的民粹主义力量？

sentences.en: That's a great question, and I think that's what everybody's watching right now.
sentences.zh: 这真是个好问题，我想这也是现在所有人都在关注的。

sentences.en: Look, a lot of these people that we kind of, you know, broadly call the 2020 possibles are a little bit like crabs in the glass right now for attention, right?
sentences.zh: 听着，我们广义上称之为2020年潜在候选人的许多人，现在就像玻璃罐里的螃蟹一样争夺关注，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, crawling all over each other.
sentences.zh: 你知道，互相踩着对方往上爬。

sentences.en: We saw Cory Booker do something else that was unprecedented, which was to criticize, to specifically go to a hearing, again, in this case, Jeff Sessions,
sentences.zh: 我们看到科里·布克做了一件前所未有的事情，那就是批评，具体是在一场听证会上——同样，在这个案例中是针对杰夫·瑟申斯——

sentences.en: and criticize a sitting fellow senator and oppose his nomination at his hearing.
sentences.zh: 并在听证会上批评同僚现任参议员并反对他的提名。

sentences.en: So a lot of people are looking to be the voice of the progressive left and the angry left and harness just anger.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多人都希望成为进步左翼和愤怒左翼的声音，并利用这种愤怒。

sentences.en: I mean, Democrats are just in a lather right now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，民主党人现在简直气急败坏。

sentences.en: They hate this president.
sentences.zh: 他们讨厌这位总统。

sentences.en: They hate his behavior.
sentences.zh: 他们讨厌他的行为。

sentences.en: They can't stand his nominees.
sentences.zh: 他们无法忍受他的被提名人。

sentences.en: There's nothing that they can do to stop them unless they can convince enough Republicans to go along with them, which basically they've not been able to do.
sentences.zh: 除非他们能说服足够的共和党人加入他们（而这基本上是他们一直没能做到的），否则他们无能为力来阻止这些人。

sentences.en: Now they're facing this epic Supreme Court battle after a bruising fight last year.
sentences.zh: 现在，在经历了去年一场激烈的争斗之后，他们又面临着这场史诗般的最高法院之争。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of this anger, and she is the right voice for that.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种愤怒情绪铺天盖地，而她正是表达这种愤怒的合适声音。

sentences.en: Whether she can have a broader appeal across the party and across the nation is very much, I agree with you, kind of remains to be seen.
sentences.zh: 至于她能否在整个党内和全国范围内产生更广泛的吸引力，我同意你的看法，这还有待观察。

sentences.en: Does she seem to relish her ability to get under Donald Trump's skin?
sentences.zh: 她似乎很享受自己能够触及唐纳德·特朗普痛处的能力吗？

sentences.en: I think of the phrase he uses to describe her, which is quite unflattering and very ethnically insensitive, Pocahontas.
sentences.zh: 我想到了他用来形容她的那个词，非常不客气且带有强烈的种族不敏感意味——“风中奇缘”（Pocahontas）。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Stemming from her controversy over claiming some sort of Native American roots as part of her entry to college.
sentences.zh: 这源于她此前声称自己拥有某种美洲原住民血统作为进入大学的一部分而引发的争议。

sentences.en: I think it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很有趣。

sentences.en: During the campaign, he had nasty names for all his Republican opponents, and he shriveled them with it.
sentences.zh: 在竞选期间，他对所有的共和党对手都有难听的称呼，并用这些绰号将他们贬得体无完肤。

sentences.en: They really never found their footing after they had been given their moniker, right?
sentences.zh: 他们在被起了绰号之后就再也没有振作起来，对吧？

sentences.en: Little Marco never escaped that, and he sort of – and in fact, it stuck with him now when he couldn't, at the end, stand up to Rex Tillerson, the nominee for secretary of state,
sentences.zh: “小马可”永远摆脱不了那个称号，而且某种程度上——事实上，这个称号一直伴随着他，当他最终无法顶住国务卿被提名人雷克斯·蒂勒森时，

sentences.en: when he said he was going to – he indicated that he might because of his stance on Russia.
sentences.zh: 当他表示自己要——由于他对俄罗斯的立场而暗示可能会支持时，

sentences.en: Little Marco came wandering back to haunt him.
sentences.zh: “小马可”的阴影又回来纠缠着他。

sentences.en: He's really created these things that have identified people, Ly and Ted.
sentences.zh: 他确实创造了这些用来给人贴标签的代号，比如“骗子特德”。

sentences.en: She's managed to still say Elizabeth Warren.
sentences.zh: 但他依然只能叫她伊丽莎白·沃伦。

sentences.en: He has not been able to change her identity and define her, and she's in fact turned it around, and somehow that thing that we all hear when you're kids, what you say about me,
sentences.zh: 他没能改变她的身份并重新定义她，她反而扭转了局面，不知怎的，我们从小听到大的那句话——你对我说的话，

sentences.en: says more about you than me.
sentences.zh: 比我对你更能说明你是谁。

sentences.en: It kind of doesn't, but in his case, vis-a-vis Elizabeth Warren, I think it does.
sentences.zh: 虽然平时未必如此，但在他与伊丽莎白·沃伦的较量中，我认为确实如此。

sentences.en: She's managed to make him look small, and I think anyone who can get under Donald Trump's skin in the party really does enjoy that, and that's probably a great deal of her power.
sentences.zh: 她成功地让他显得很渺小，我想党内任何能戳到唐纳德·特朗普痛处的人其实都很享受这一点，这可能正是她力量的很大一部分来源。

sentences.en: Jennifer, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs, in the era of vinyl, every night, you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在我在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，每天晚上，你都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，把DJ台变成这样一个，

sentences.en: like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 宛如充满美感、历经50年岁月的珍贵文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼（Audemars Piguet）的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Dana.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫达娜。

sentences.en: I am a subscriber to The New York Times, but my husband isn't, and it would be really nice to be able to share a recipe or an article or compete with him in Wordle or Connections.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的订户，但我丈夫不是，如果能和他一起分享食谱或文章，或者在 Wordle 或 Connections 上一较高下，那就太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Dana, we heard you.
sentences.zh: 达娜，我们听到了。

sentences.en: It's why we created The New York Times Family Subscription.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们推出《纽约时报》家庭订阅服务的原因。

sentences.en: One subscription, up to four separate logins for anyone in your life.
sentences.zh: 一个订阅，最多可供生活中四个不同的人分别登录。

sentences.en: Find out more at nytimes.com slash family.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash family 了解更多信息。

sentences.en: How did you get this letter?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么弄到这封信的？

sentences.en: I don't think I can tell you that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我不能告诉你。

sentences.en: This letter is considered so coveted slash private.
sentences.zh: 这封信被视为极受追捧且高度机密。

sentences.en: Every page of every copy that I know about is watermarked with people's name, the recipient's name on it.
sentences.zh: 我所知道的每一份复印件的每一页都带有水印，印有收件人的名字。

sentences.en: My copy went out the source.
sentences.zh: 我的那份是从源头流出的。

sentences.en: It's like a Hollywood script.
sentences.zh: 这就像是好莱坞剧本。

sentences.en: And yet it's an investment document.
sentences.zh: 然而它却是一份投资文件。

sentences.en: And yet it's an investment document.
sentences.zh: 然而它却是一份投资文件。

sentences.en: On Wall Street, there's a letter being whispered about, one that everyone wants a copy of, but very few people have actually seen.
sentences.zh: 在华尔街，有一封信正在私下流传，人人都想得到副本，但真正见过的人寥寥无几。

sentences.en: Andrew Sorkin is one of the people who has seen it.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·索尔金就是见过它的人之一。

sentences.en: He's a business columnist at The Times, and this elusive letter he got, it's written by an equally elusive money manager, Seth Klarman.
sentences.zh: 他是《时报》的商业专栏作家，这封他得到的难得的信件，是由同样神秘的基金经理赛斯·克拉曼撰写的。

sentences.en: Most people don't know him, but within the world of investing, he is a legend.
sentences.zh: 大多数人不认识他，但在投资界，他是个传奇。

sentences.en: He is a giant.
sentences.zh: 他是个巨擘。

sentences.en: He is the second coming of Warren Buffett to some degree.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他是沃伦·巴菲特的再世。

sentences.en: Among the investment class, he is it.
sentences.zh: 在投资界，他就是标杆。

sentences.en: It's an explicit set of guidelines, a manifesto, answering a question that millions of Americans have been asking since November 9th.
sentences.zh: 这是一套明确的准则，一份宣言，回答了自 11 月 9 日以来数百万美国人一直在问的问题。

sentences.en: How should you invest your money in the Trump era?
sentences.zh: 在特朗普时代，你应该如何投资你的资金？

sentences.en: So this letter you obtained, what exactly does it say?
sentences.zh: 那么你弄到的这封信，里面究竟写了些什么？

sentences.en: Since Donald Trump was elected, the market has gone on this remarkable run.
sentences.zh: 自从唐纳德·特朗普当选以来，市场就迎来了一波惊人的涨势。

sentences.en: In the 48 hours since Donald Trump was elected to the Oval Office, the stock market has rallied, reaching new heights at each close.
sentences.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普当选总统后的 48 小时内，股市大幅反弹，每次收盘都创下新高。

sentences.en: Take a look at the boards now.
sentences.zh: 现在来看看盘面。

sentences.en: On the expectation among investors and businesses that there's going to be tax reform, so taxes are going to be lower, which means higher profits,
sentences.zh: 基于投资者和企业的预期，即将会进行税制改革，因此税率会降低，这意味着更高的利润，

sentences.en: that there's going to be different trade policies, that there's going to be infrastructure spending.
sentences.zh: 即会有不同的贸易政策，会有基础设施支出。

sentences.en: To expect the Dow to crack 20K for the first time in its 120-year history, and it is done.
sentences.zh: 预计道琼斯指数在其 120 年的历史中首次突破 2 万点，而它做到了。

sentences.en: Our grandchildren will remember.
sentences.zh: 我们的子孙后代都会铭记。

sentences.en: The market has been on a tear.
sentences.zh: 市场一直势如破竹。

sentences.en: His letter effectively said, not so faSt.
sentences.zh: 他的信实际上在说，没那么快。

sentences.en: I'm not sure this is actually how it's going to go.
sentences.zh: 我不确定事情真的会按这个方向发展。

sentences.en: In fact, I'm worried it's going to go the opposite direction.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我担心它会朝相反方向发展。

sentences.en: So there's two elements it feels like worth breaking down.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得有两点值得剖析。

sentences.en: The first is what does he fear that an America-first economic vision will do?
sentences.zh: 第一点是，他担心美国优先的经济愿景会导致什么结果？

sentences.en: Well, I think what he's looking at right now is he's saying to himself, you know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想他现在看到的情况是，他在心里的想法是，你知道的，

sentences.en: you can create jobs in America by forcing companies and jawboning companies to create a new factory here, but that that isn't long-term work.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过强迫和施压企业在这里建立新工厂来在美国创造就业机会，但这并不是长久之计。

sentences.en: Meaning in the age of technology and AI and robotics, you can't hold back the march of progress.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，在科技、人工智能和机器人时代，你无法阻挡前进的步伐。

sentences.en: Technology is going to take these jobs anyway.
sentences.zh: 技术无论如何都会夺走这些工作。

sentences.en: So it just feels good, but it actually isn't really going to be-
sentences.zh: 所以这只是感觉良好，但实际上并不会——

sentences.en: It's a sugar high.
sentences.zh: 这就像打了一剂兴奋剂。

sentences.en: It's a sugar high.
sentences.zh: 这就像打了一剂兴奋剂。

sentences.en: So the second thing Klarman brings up, and I want you to explain this because it's complicated, is inflation and why he thinks that the Trump economic agenda will be inflationary.
sentences.zh: 所以克拉曼提出的第二点，我想请你解释一下，因为这很复杂，那就是通货膨胀，以及为什么他认为特朗普的经济议程会引发通胀。

sentences.en: What he thinks is about to happen is you're going to temporarily inflate the economy through these short-term measures.
sentences.zh: 他认为即将发生的是，你将通过这些短期措施暂时刺激经济。

sentences.en: That is going to force the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates.
sentences.zh: 这将迫使美联储提高利率。

sentences.en: Which makes borrowing more expensive.
sentences.zh: 这使得借贷成本更高。

sentences.en: Which makes borrowing more expensive.
sentences.zh: 这使得借贷成本更高。

sentences.en: But it doesn't just make your credit card more expensive.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅让你的信用卡账单更高。

sentences.en: It makes all of the things the government has paid for effectively on its credit card that much more expensive.
sentences.zh: 它让政府实际上用信用卡支付的所有项目都变得更加昂贵。

sentences.en: So all of a sudden, the bill is going to be so much higher- For everyone.
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间，账单会高得多——对每个人而言。

sentences.en: For everybody.
sentences.zh: 对每一个人。

sentences.en: But he put some language in his letter that I thought was interesting for an investment manager.
sentences.zh: 但他在信中使用了一些语言，我觉得对于一个投资经理来说很有意思。

sentences.en: And let me read you a quote.
sentences.zh: 让我给你读一段引言。

sentences.en: This one is about Donald Trump's leadership style.
sentences.zh: 这段是关于唐纳德·特朗普的领导风格的。

sentences.en: Klarman wrote that the erratic tendencies and overconfidence in his own wisdom and judgment that Donald Trump has demonstrated to date are inconsistent with strong leadership and sound decision-making.
sentences.zh: 克拉曼写道，唐纳德·特朗普迄今表现出的反复无常的倾向以及对他自身智慧和判断力的过度自信，与强有力的领导和明智的决策背道而驰。

sentences.en: That sounds like a form of investment advice in its own way.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上听起来像是一种投资建议。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Seth Klarman and every investor to some degree are in the business of betting on executives and leadership style.
sentences.zh: 赛斯·克拉曼和每一位投资者在某种程度上都从事着押注高管和领导风格的生意。

sentences.en: When you buy a stock or invest in a company, you're deciding that the people who are leading it are doing the right things and are going to make the right choices.
sentences.zh: 当你买入一只股票或投资一家公司时，你是在认定领导它的人正在做正确的事情，并且将做出正确的选择。

sentences.en: And that's what he's doing in the political context.
sentences.zh: 这就是他在政治背景下所做的事情。

sentences.en: There's one big caveat to mention about this letter, which is to say that despite what Seth Klarman has described, we don't know right this minute how he's actually investing.
sentences.zh: 关于这封信，有一个需要说明的重要前提，那就是尽管赛斯·克拉曼描述了这些，但此时此刻我们并不知道他实际是如何投资的。

sentences.en: There are investors that say certain things publicly, often about politics, but sometimes their investments aren't necessarily aligned.
sentences.zh: 有些投资者会公开说某些话，通常是关于政治的，但有时他们的投资并不一定与之保持一致。

sentences.en: Warren Buffett very famously- In just a minute, I'm going to talk about my favorite subject, which is going to be- For the past year, he campaigned in support of Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 沃伦·巴菲特非常著名地——过一会儿，我要谈谈我最喜欢的话题，那就是——在过去的一年里，他一直在为竞选活动出力支持希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: But Hillary can and will do in the eight years following January 20th.
sentences.zh: 以及希拉里在 1 月 20 日之后的八年里能够并且将会做的事情。

sentences.en: I think he was actually helping take people to the voting booth- To get her elected.
sentences.zh: 我认为他实际上是在帮助人们走进投票站——为了让她当选。

sentences.en: To get her elected.
sentences.zh: 为了让她当选。

sentences.en: There have been a couple of things said by Donald Trump in the last few weeks.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在过去几周里说了一些话。

sentences.en: Wait till you hear them, man.
sentences.zh: 等听了这些，老兄。

sentences.en: You'll really boo.
sentences.zh: 你真的会嘘声一片。

sentences.en: And yet, after Donald Trump won, he has put something on the order of $12 billion with a B to work, meaning he's invested more money in the stock market, betting it would go up.
sentences.zh: 然而，在唐纳德·特朗普获胜后，他投入了大约 120 亿美元（带 B 的十亿级别）资金运作，这意味着他在股市上投入了更多资金，押注它会走高。

sentences.en: To capitalize on the Trump economic boomlet.
sentences.zh: 以利用特朗普的经济小繁荣。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And by the way, thus far, he's been right.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，到目前为止，他是对的。

sentences.en: I think the reason we care about Klarman, besides his kind of past record, is that everyone's trying to get to the bottom of an essential question, which is,
sentences.zh: 我想我们之所以关注克拉曼，除了他过去的记录之外，是因为每个人都在试图弄清一个核心问题，那就是，

sentences.en: is the Trump economic boom a bubble?
sentences.zh: 特朗普的经济繁荣是个泡沫吗？

sentences.en: Is it real?
sentences.zh: 它是真实的吗？

sentences.en: I think the consensus view among the investment elite at the moment is that they want all of these things to happen.
sentences.zh: 我认为投资精英阶层目前的共识是，他们希望所有这些事情都能发生。

sentences.en: They want tax reform to happen and taxes to go lower.
sentences.zh: 他们希望税改发生，税率降低。

sentences.en: They want infrastructure spending.
sentences.zh: 他们希望有基础设施支出。

sentences.en: They want all of these things to happen, but they're praying it's real.
sentences.zh: 他们希望所有这些事情都能发生，但他们祈祷这是真的。

sentences.en: But they know that it may not be.
sentences.zh: 但他们知道可能并非如此。

sentences.en: Thank you, Andrew.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，安德鲁。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Donald Trump has his eighth cabinet member, and it's another polarizing one.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普有了他的第八位内阁成员，这也是一个两极分化的任命。

sentences.en: Alabama Senator Jeff Sessions is now the attorney general, despite Elizabeth Warren's protests.
sentences.zh: 尽管伊丽莎白·沃伦抗议，但阿拉巴马州参议员杰夫·塞申斯现在成为了司法部长。

sentences.en: President Trump lashed out at the panel of federal judges deciding the legality of his immigration ban.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统猛烈抨击了决定其移民禁令合法性的联邦法官小组。

sentences.en: It would be so great for a justice system if they would be able to read a statement and do what's right.
sentences.zh: 如果司法系统能够阅读声明并做正确的事，那对他们来说将是太棒了。

sentences.en: He called the judges disgraceful, which seemed to unsettle his Supreme Court nominee, Judge Neil Gorsuch, who described Trump's attacks as demoralizing and disheartening.
sentences.zh: 他称这些法官可耻，这似乎让他的最高法院提名人、法官尼尔·戈萨奇感到不安，戈萨奇将特朗普的攻击描述为令人士气低落和令人沮丧的。

sentences.en: That could be an attempt by Gorsuch to distance himself from the president, or he could be trying to reassure Democratic senators who have the power to block his confirmation.
sentences.zh: 这可能是戈萨奇试图与总统保持距离的尝试，或者他可能是在试图安抚那些有权阻止其获得确认的民主党参议员。

sentences.en: The president has also found a new target for his derision, a department store.
sentences.zh: 总统还为他的嘲讽找到了一个新目标，一家百货公司。

sentences.en: He scolded Nordstrom for dropping his daughter Ivanka's clothing line.
sentences.zh: 他斥责诺德斯特龙下架了他女儿伊万卡的服装系列。

sentences.en: She's a good person, he tweeted, always pushing me to do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 他在推特上写道，她是个好人，总是推动我做正确的事。

sentences.en: While Nordstrom may have accidentally waded into presidential politics, the rest of the fashion industry is trying to be much more restrained at their annual runway shows,
sentences.zh: 虽然诺德斯特龙可能无意中卷入了总统政治，但时尚界的其余品牌正试图在他们的年度时装秀上表现得更加克制，

sentences.en: which begin this week in New York.
sentences.zh: 本周在纽约开幕的时装秀。

sentences.en: Fashion has always been very careful about separating their personal politics from their product politics.
sentences.zh: 时尚界一直非常小心，将个人的政治倾向与产品的政治属性区分开来。

sentences.en: In 2016, designers became publicly political and, in fact, political on the runways in a way that I think was pretty much unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 在 2016 年，设计师们公开谈论政治，事实上在T台上谈论政治的方式，我认为可以说是前所未有的。

sentences.en: Vanessa Friedman is the fashion critic for The Times.
sentences.zh: 凡妮莎·弗里德曼是《时报》的时尚评论家。

sentences.en: So I think that we're going to see if the statements occur on the runway, you know, however they are.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们将拭目以待，看看这些言论是否会出现在T台上，你知道的，无论以何种形式。

sentences.en: If we get slogans, if we get specific kind of casting of models that, you know, underscore diversity and immigration potentially.
sentences.zh: 如果我们听到口号，如果我们看到特定选角的模特，你知道的，潜在地强调多样性和移民。

sentences.en: If we get clothing that clearly references, you know, other cultures in a way that might be more pointed than in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 如果我们看到的服装明显借鉴了，你知道的，其他文化，其方式可能比以往更加尖锐。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。
